description: Test suite for the ChatLog component, including various unit tests verifying behavior such as message capping, pruning, rendering, and managing pending user messages.

classes.name: ChatLog
classes.description: A class representing the chat log component, handling message addition, rendering, pruning, and management of chat entries.

methods.name: addSystem
methods.description: Adds a system message to the chat log.

methods.name: startAssistant
methods.description: Starts an assistant message thread with a given name and run ID.

methods.name: updateAssistant
methods.description: Updates an existing assistant message based on run ID.

methods.name: addUser
methods.description: Adds a user message to the chat log.

methods.name: showBtw
methods.description: Displays a 'Between' message with a question and text.

methods.name: hasVisibleBtw
methods.description: Checks if the 'Between' message is visible.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Clears all messages, with an option to preserve pending user messages.

methods.name: restorePendingUsers
methods.description: Restores pending user messages after a history rebuild.

methods.name: countPendingUsers
methods.description: Returns the count of pending user messages.

methods.name: commitPendingUser
methods.description: Marks a pending user message as committed.

methods.name: reconcilePendingUsers
methods.description: Reconciles a list of pending user messages against the current chat history, based on timestamps.
